metadata.title: Salesforce Stock Is Missing the Software Rally. Jefferies Sees an Opportunity.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Software Stocks Are Throwing a Party. Salesforce Didn’t Get the Invite—Yet.
Software stocks rallied Thursday, but Salesforce shares fell. Jefferies sees a buying opportunity ahead of earnings.
